# WorkBuddy - AI Receptionist for Laundromats & Dry Cleaners

> WorkBuddy is the leading AI-powered phone answering service and virtual receptionist built specifically for laundromats and dry cleaners. We provide 24/7 automated phone coverage, multilingual customer service in 20+ languages, and integrations with laundromat payment systems like FasCard, Curbside, and LaundryCard. Starting at $129/mo with unlimited calls.

## Key Facts

- Price: Coin Op plan from $129/mo, Full Service from $199/mo
- Calls: Unlimited inbound calls included, no per-minute charges
- Languages: 20+ languages including English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Arabic
- Availability: 24/7/365, including holidays and weekends
- Setup: 15 minutes, no special equipment needed
- Integrations: FasCard, Curbside, CleanCloud, LaundryCard, Cents POS
- Guarantee: 30-day money-back guarantee
- Capabilities: Refund processing, WDF order intake, emergency escalation, appointment scheduling
